# Saurabh (relativist1) · Theoretical Astrophysicist

> Saurabh is a theoretical astrophysicist. He is a Postdoctoral Research Associate in AI³ (Astronomical Imaging × Astrophysical Inference × Artificial Intelligence) at the BASP lab, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, from December 2026, and a member of the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) Collaboration. He works on black-hole imaging and very-long-baseline interferometry (VLBI): theory, simulations (GRMHD and ray tracing) and image analysis. PhD in astrophysics from the Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy, Bonn (2026). Saurabh has a single name and no surname; in papers he appears as "Saurabh" (sometimes indexed as "Saurabh K." or "Kumar, Saurabh"). Online handle: relativist1.
